$comment: Per-role model binding for CodeBuddy subagents. Values are what `codebuddy --model` accepts: the tier aliases (default-model, fast-model, balanced-model, primary-model, deep-model), a concrete model id (glm-5.3, kimi-k3, gpt-5.6-terra, ...), or a custom model as `custom-local:<id>`. Tier aliases are the recommended default: CodeBuddy resolves them to whatever the account offers, so routing keeps working when you switch models. An empty string keeps the session default. `effort` is the CodeBuddy agent frontmatter field of the same name.
